tasks.title: Письмо другу
tasks.instructions: Write an email to a friend inviting them to visit you next month. Say what you can do together and how to get to your city.

tasks.title: Эссе-мнение: онлайн-обучение
tasks.instructions: "Online learning is as effective as learning in a classroom." Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples from your own experience.

tasks.title: Отзыв о фильме или книге
tasks.instructions: Write a review of a film or book you enjoyed recently. Describe it briefly, say what was good and what could be better, and recommend it to a specific type of person.
